findings.title: Policy target prohibition conflicts with the canonical manifest

resolution.reason: MUT-V2-003 与 MUT-V2-004 已改为指向新增的直接保障测试；规格要求它们分别触达 _v2_evidence_current 的 non-passing required-check 拒绝和 _v2_gate_facts 的非 killed mutation 拒绝。

findings.title: Two declared detectors do not reach their mutation targets

summary: The frozen manifest design is not yet implementable as an auditable detector contract: target and target_symbol are ambiguous, the Policy-target prohibition conflicts with the required policy.py mutation, and two declared detectors do not execute their stated enforcement points.
